Name: ✦ Blink
Description: <light_purple>It still doesn't have the trick down — for now, it just gets there faster and hits much, much harder.
- A <green><bold>Pickup</bold> <reset>reach worthy of a born block-carrier
- A <blue><bold>Sprint</bold> <reset>burst standing in for the vanish it hasn't learned yet
- Front-loaded burst <red><bold>Damage</bold> <reset>— most of it lands by level 30
- A lean <red><bold>Life</bold> <reset>pool: it plans on not being where the hit lands

Notifications.20: <light_purple>It hesitates at the edge of every jump — Blink hasn't quite learned the trick yet.
Notifications.70: <light_purple>One day it'll be gone before you blink. Today, it's just fast.
